object BankOrderReadsideProjectionHandler {
  /** Hook trait bound in DI for custom readside transformation or enrichment semantics. */
  trait Bindings {
    def onUnmatchedEvent(envelope: EventEnvelope[Any]): Future[Done] = Future.successful(Done)

  object DefaultBindings extends Bindings
}

final class BankOrderReadsideProjectionHandler(
  repository: BankOrderReadsideRepository,
  bindings: BankOrderReadsideProjectionHandler.Bindings = BankOrderReadsideProjectionHandler.DefaultBindings
)(implicit ec: ExecutionContext) extends Handler[EventEnvelope[Any]] {
  override def process(envelope: EventEnvelope[Any]): Future[Done] =
    envelope.event match {
      case e: FundOrderEntity.CashRequestSourceRecorded =>
        val base = BankOrderView(clientRequestId = envelope.persistenceId)

    }
}
